decisions.reason: As a newly launched dental consumable with its own web page and clear fit to the firm's established thermoforming and laboratory workflow business, it is likely performing near aspiration and the firm's size gives enough slack to continue it.

This PETG thermoforming blank sits squarely in the firm's core dental materials range and the dedicated presentation suggests commitment, so a large established firm would usually keep it while market feedback is still developing.

The UV-curing lacquer had weaker visibility than the other launches, which hints at more uncertain results, but its adjacency to the firm's materials business and available organisational slack still make retention more likely than withdrawal after only one year.

The intraoral contrast spray supports digital dental workflows that match the company's strategic direction, and its standalone presentation indicates enough promise to keep it unless results clearly miss aspirations.

The custom earmold line is closely aligned with the firm's custom-device capabilities in hearing care, so even with limited early evidence management would likely continue it while scaling international sales.

Custom hearing protection earmolds are a related extension of the hearing-care business and likely benefit from shared production know-how, so a large incumbent would usually keep them unless early performance showed a clear shortfall.
